title: Lab 1C — WAF on CloudFront
topic: WAF Web ACL scope CLOUDFRONT vs REGIONAL, managed rule groups, Shield Standard, Firewall Manager, SQLi blocking on api/wiki*, cost teardown
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces Night 4 saa-study-globalskiatlas-waf lab on globalskiatlas.com. Answer without night-4-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×2 B×3 C×2 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: You attach a WAF Web ACL with CLOUDFRONT scope to a CloudFront distribution. In which Region must you create that Web ACL?

options.A: Any Region where the origin S3 bucket or API Gateway currently resides
options.B: us-east-1 (N. Virginia) only for WAF resources used with CloudFront
options.C: eu-west-1 to match the closest viewers serving European edge traffic
options.D: The same Region as the API Gateway REST API behind the /api/* paths

questions.question: You later add an Application Load Balancer in us-east-1 for a new API. Which WAF scope applies to that ALB?

options.A: CLOUDFRONT — all WAF ACLs are global regardless of the protected resource
options.B: GLOBAL — Shield Advanced scope replaces WAF for Application Load Balancers
options.C: REGIONAL — created in the same Region as the ALB or API Gateway Regional
options.D: EDGE — only CloudFront Functions can attach WAF rules to ALB listeners

questions.question: Managed rules include CommonRuleSet, KnownBadInputs, and SQLiRuleSet. A legitimate wiki POST returns 403 after attach. What is the first troubleshooting step?

options.A: Delete the Cognito user pool so all write requests become anonymous GET traffic
options.B: Disable TLS on CloudFront so WAF can inspect plaintext request bodies
options.C: Move DynamoDB tables to Aurora so SQLi managed rules no longer apply
options.D: Inspect WAF sampled requests / CloudWatch metrics for the blocking rule

questions.question: Which AWS service provides free automatic protection against common network and transport layer DDoS on CloudFront?

options.A: AWS WAF SQLi managed rule group alone cannot stop L3/L4 volumetric floods
options.B: AWS Shield Standard — included at no extra charge for CloudFront and Route 53
options.C: AWS Network Firewall on the VPC subnet behind the CloudFront origin path
options.D: Amazon GuardDuty S3 Protection watching object-level API activity patterns

questions.question: You need stateful inspection and filtering of east-west traffic between subnets inside a VPC (not HTTP at CloudFront). Which service fits?

options.A: AWS WAF Web ACL with CLOUDFRONT scope attached to the CloudFront distribution
options.B: Security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on all ports for east-west flows
options.C: CloudFront Function redirecting viewers to a canonical hostname
options.D: AWS Network Firewall deployed in VPC subnets for traffic inspection

questions.question: GET wiki pages and POST with valid Cognito JWT should pass; a curl probe with SQL injection in the body should be blocked. Which layer enforces the SQLi block?

options.A: S3 bucket policy Deny on suspicious object keys matching injection patterns
options.B: AWS WAF inspecting HTTP requests at CloudFront before origin forward
options.C: DynamoDB condition expression on the wiki table partition key for writers
options.D: Cognito PreventUserExistenceErrors setting on the user pool client

questions.question: After a lab, the Web ACL is detached and deleted to avoid ongoing WAF cost. What still protects the CloudFront distribution at L3/L4?

options.A: Nothing — CloudFront is fully public without any AWS DDoS mitigation left
options.B: WAF continues blocking SQLi even after Web ACL deletion via edge cache
options.C: API Gateway resource policy replaces all edge security for the distribution
options.D: AWS Shield Standard on the CloudFront distribution remains automatically

questions.question: A company with 50 AWS accounts wants one central team to deploy the same WAF managed rule groups to all CloudFront distributions. Which service?

options.A: AWS Firewall Manager with organization-wide WAF security policies
options.B: IAM Access Analyzer external access findings across member accounts
options.C: AWS Config aggregator listing CloudFront distributions for compliance
options.D: Replace WAF with security group rules attached to the S3 origin bucket

questions.question: Rate-based rules in AWS WAF are commonly used to mitigate which threat on a public wiki API?

options.A: Brute-force or abusive HTTP request floods from a single source IP
options.B: Cross-Region Aurora failover during an Availability Zone outage event
options.C: KMS customer master key rotation scheduled every 365 days by policy
options.D: S3 Intelligent-Tiering moving objects to lower-cost storage classes

questions.question: WAF on an internal ALB in a VPC serving HTTPS from clients in the same Region uses which scope and attachment point?

options.A: CLOUDFRONT scope attached in us-east-1 to the ALB listener ARN
options.B: GLOBAL scope on the Route 53 hosted zone only — ALBs cannot use WAF
options.C: REGIONAL scope Web ACL associated directly with the ALB or API Gateway
options.D: EDGE scope via Lambda@Edge attached only to the S3 origin behavior
